method: First-second mono mean of browser stereo decode vs offline FFmpeg at matched rates; onset-bearing interval 80–750 ms; constant +/-64-frame lag search and fitted gain. No perceptual listening or acoustic/display measurement. No proportional retiming.
browser: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/153.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
calibration_basis: Best measured constant digital decoder lag is zero; physical output remains uncalibrated.
threshold_note: Raw first-crossing thresholds differ because the FFmpeg mono downmix and browser stereo average have different amplitudes. Gain-fitted waveform correlation, not the raw threshold difference, estimates constant timing offset.
